Alex Rosen is an American internet personality and activist known for his involvement in exposing alleged instances of child exploitation through his organization, Predator Poachers. Rosen gained attention for his controversial methods, often involving confrontations recorded and shared on social media platforms.

His activities have drawn both support and criticism, with some praising his dedication to addressing child exploitation and others condemning his tactics as potentially harmful, legally questionable, and attention seeking. Critics argue that his confrontational style and lack of coordination with law enforcement agencies can impede official investigations.

Rosen has made multiple appearances on Infowars.
